<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Try LEFT
result = action(['LEFT'])
print(f"After LEFT: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, done={result.get('done')}, board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}, no_impact={result.get('no_impact')}")

# Check player position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        player = n
        break
if player:
    p_center = (sum(p[0] for p in player['boundary'])//len(player['boundary']), sum(p[1] for p in player['boundary'])//len(player['boundary']))
    print(f"Player at: {p_center}")

# Check if there's a difference between current frame and initial frame
# Look at history to find the initial state
print(f"\nHistory length: {len(history)}")
if history:
    # Check the first frame
    first_frame = history[0].frame
    first_seg = first_frame.segmentation
    first_player = None
    for n in first_seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'b':
            first_player = n
            break
    if first_player:
        fp_center = (sum(p[0] for p in first_player['boundary'])//len(first_player['boundary']), sum(p[1] for p in first_player['boundary'])//len(first_player['boundary']))
        print(f"Initial player at: {fp_center}")
    
    # Check current vs first frame
    print(f"Current step: {current_frame.step}, Initial step: {first_frame.step}")
    
    # Check if any nodes are different
    current_ids = {n['id'] for n in seg['nodes']}
    first_ids = {n['id'] for n in first_seg['nodes']}
    print(f"Current nodes: {len(current_ids)}, Initial nodes: {len(first_ids)}")
    
    # Check for charcoal cell in both
    current_c = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c']
    first_c = [n for n in first_seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c']
    print(f"Current charcoal: {[(n['id'], n['pixels']) for n in current_c]}")
    print(f"Initial charcoal: {[(n['id'], n['pixels']) for n in first_c]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
